game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep warm lanterns safe from snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep warm lanterns safe from snow wraiths. Each round, snow wraiths strike the larder door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the larder door from snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace: keep the scope_safe meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: scope_safe drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Aurora Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while scope_safe > 0.
